handwritten_decision_vectors: Current contract-decision-vectors are frozen acceptance input seeds, not the generated conformance/public-contract/** output authority. Implementations may not rewrite these expected results to pass.
decision_artifact_aggregate: Definition and implementation inputs are bound by explicit manifests; no old six-file aggregate represents R2 closure.
role_sequence: Stage 1: R2 public source and generated contracts, Core and Read; actual pack independent review and commander acceptance
Stage 2 after Stage 1 acceptance: real 2A-2D language, CLI, SDK, Agent and service consumers, bound to accepted artifacts
current_authority: Single public semantic source implements the full accepted R2 definition and S12-D001/D002/D003 bindings. Public normative artifacts are distinct from historical proof and stage acceptance. No consumer may redefine R2.

ir_retention.presence: Copy only own present keys from the same Core-validated Payload. No defaults; absence differs from an explicit empty array.
ir_retention.meaning: Risk is an authored declaration, not verified quality or permission. Noncritical extensions retain typed opaque SemanticValue and array order; unsupported critical semantics still reject interpretation.
ir_retention.projection: Necessary asset declarations remain in whole_asset/exact_selection/related expand; catalog may omit declarations with not_in_mode. Preserve Host scope, error order, and complete final-body budgeting.
